copy.tagline: 管理 iOS 应用在 App Store Connect 上的发布与测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要通过 API 自动化苹果商店的应用管理流程
copy.tagline_en: Manage iOS app releases and TestFlight builds via App Store Connect API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app management on Apple's App Store Connect via API

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能管理你的 App Store Connect 上的 iOS/macOS 应用，包括查看构建状态、分发 TestFlight 测试、提交 App Review 和获取分析数据。
howto.when: 当你需要管理 App Store Connect 上的应用（如查看构建、TestFlight 分发、App Review 提交等）时，Claude 会自动处理认证和 API 操作。

say.text: 查看我刚上传的 iOS 构建版状态
say.note: Claude 会查询构建处理状态并告诉你是否可用。

say.text: 提交当前版本进行 TestFlight 外部测试
say.note: Claude 会检查资格并触发分发。

say.text: 检查我的 App Review 提交进度
say.note: Claude 会获取最新的审阅状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage your iOS/macOS apps on App Store Connect, including checking build status, distributing TestFlight builds, submitting App Review, and retrieving analytics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to manage apps on App Store Connect, such as checking builds, TestFlight distribution, or App Review submission. Claude handles authentication and API calls automatically.

say_en.text: Check the status of my latest iOS build
say_en.note: Claude queries the build processing state.

say_en.text: Submit the current version for external TestFlight testing
say_en.note: Claude checks eligibility and initiates distribution.

say_en.text: Review the progress of my App Store submission
say_en.note: Claude fetches the latest review status.
